author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 흔한 겨울철새로, 늪지대와 초원, 호수, 저수지에서 지낸다. 넓적한 부리로 물을 걸러 플랑크톤과 물속 곤충, 물풀 등을 먹는 수면성 오리다. 유라시아 대륙 북부와 북아메리카 북부에서 번식하고, 유럽 남부, 북아프리카, 인도, 동남아시아, 중국 남부, 한국, 북아메리카 남부 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: long, broad spatulate bill in both sexes

points.ko: 수컷 변환깃의 노란 눈, 밝은 날개덮깃
points.en: eclipse male: bright yellow eye, pale wing coverts

sexes.male: 금속광택이 도는 청록색 머리에 등은 검고 가슴은 희며, 배 부분이 붉다. 부리는 검고 넓적하며 다리는 주황색이다. 변환깃에서는 부리 색이 암컷과 같아지지만 선명한 노란 눈과 밝은 날개덮깃으로 암컷과 구별된다.
sexes.female: 다른 오리 암컷처럼 수수한 갈색이며, 눈은 갈색이고 부리는 검은빛 도는 갈색이다. 넓적한 부리로 다른 종과 쉽게 구별된다.

art.subject: Northern Shoveler (Spatula clypeata), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean reservoirs from November to April: head glossy dark bottle-green with a metallic blue-green sheen; bright golden-yellow eye; lower neck and breast white; flanks and belly rich chestnut; a white patch in front of the black undertail and rump; back black, the long scapulars striped black and white; tail dark with white sides. Very long, broad, spoon-shaped black bill; orange legs.
art.pose: swimming low with the broad bill held in the water to filter food
art.scene: Korean winter: open reservoir edge with marshy shallows and dry grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing at the water's edge: glossy green head, yellow eye, white breast, chestnut flanks and belly, black back, long broad black spatulate bill, orange legs
adult female, side view swimming: mottled brown plumage, brown eye, very broad brownish bill with dull orange along the edges
eclipse male, side view swimming: female-like brown plumage but a bright yellow eye, pale blue forewing coverts showing, broad bill coloured like the female's
art.build: Medium-sized dabbling duck, about 50cm, close to a Mallard in size but front-heavy, with a short neck and an enormous bill that makes the head look small. Bill longer than the head, widening towards the tip into a spoon, with fine comb-like plates along its edges. Legs short and orange. Swims low with the bill held level or swept through the surface water to filter food. In flight a pale blue forewing, a white bar and a green speculum, with the wings set far back.
avoid: Do not paint a normal-sized yellow bill or a white neck ring; that is Mallard (Anas platyrhynchos).
Do not make the breast chestnut and the flanks white; the breast is white and the flanks chestnut.
Do not paint a red or dark eye on the male; it is bright yellow.
Do not narrow the bill towards the tip; it widens into a broad spoon.
